WITH order_payment_totals AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id AS order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0)) > 1 THEN 'installments'
            ELSE 'no_installments'
        END AS payment_installments_indicator,
        ABS(SUM(COALESCE(op.payment_value, 0))) AS order_value
    FROM order_payments AS op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
    opt.payment_installments_indicator AS payment_installments_indicator,
    AVG(opt.order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM order_payment_totals AS opt
INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = opt.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months')
  AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY opt.payment_installments_indicator
ORDER BY opt.payment_installments_indicator;
